app.name: WiiJukebox
app.long_description: Native LAN client prototype. Discovers WiiJukebox servers, browses configured music sources with the D-pad or pointer, shows album art and seeks within tracks, and plays their persistent MP3 stream. Press 2 for the projectM visualizer; B returns to browsing. Set up services in the server web UI first. Same LAN required; allow TCP and UDP port 4005. GPLv3; fonts OFL. The graphical interface is new and experimental.
